pathAssistantSteps.info: Cancelled, usually because the deputation was withdrawn.
Handed over to the ministry / mission. Terminal state.
Dispatch to the ministry or mission, not to a residential address.
Verify the ministry's clearance letter, deputation order and the Clearance Level claimed on the application.
Diplomatic / Official draft. Set Passport Category (Diplomatic or Official) and Clearance Level. 60-page booklet only.
Granting is restricted to the Consular, Passport and Visa (CPV) division. Ministry clearance must be on file.
Fee settled or waiver recorded by the ministry.
Diplomatic and Official passports are normally fee-exempt. Raise a payment record only if the ministry is being billed.
No PV - the sponsoring ministry's clearance replaces police verification.
60-page diplomatic / official booklet queued for printing at the secure facility.
Rejected - ministry clearance withheld or Clearance Level not substantiated.
Submitted. Requires a Political Clearance / No Objection Certificate from the sponsoring ministry and an official identity certificate.
